## Decisions

- **Use pg_trgm GIN index on drive_files.name in the extensions schema**: Enables fast substring and fuzzy document search without external search infrastructure.
- **Enforce XOR (num_nonnulls = 1) on drive_root_access and google_calendars**: Guarantees each access grant or calendar maps to exactly one role or one group, keeping RLS resolution deterministic.
- **Capture event_google_links in a BEFORE DELETE trigger**: The link rows cascade away with the event, so the delete push payload must be built before the cascade runs.
